title: Donald Trump: Unusual
titleZh: 唐纳德·特朗普：不同寻常
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this report for Learning English. Hai Do was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来"美国总统"系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about Donald Trump, the 45th U.S. president.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来讲述唐纳德·特朗普的故事，他是美国第45任总统。

sentences.en: He was elected in 2016.
sentences.zh: 他在2016年当选。

sentences.en: Because his presidency is so new, this program will not discuss his time in office.
sentences.zh: 由于他的任期非常短暂，本节目不会讨论他任职期间的情况。

sentences.en: Instead, it will discuss his early life.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们将聚焦他的早年生活。

sentences.en: And it will note a few ways that Trump’s background is unusual compared to most U.S. presidents.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们也会指出特朗普的背景与美国大多数总统相比有几个不寻常之处。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was born in Queens, a borough of New York City.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普出生于纽约市皇后区。

sentences.en: He was the fourth child.
sentences.zh: 他是家里的第四个孩子。

sentences.en: He had two brothers and two sisters.
sentences.zh: 他有两位兄弟和两位姐妹。

sentences.en: His mother had been born in Scotland.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲出生于苏格兰。

sentences.en: His father, whose relatives were German, became a successful businessman in New York.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲家族是德国人，在纽约成为了一名成功的商人。

sentences.en: Donald and his two brothers helped their father in the family business.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德和他的两位兄弟帮助父亲经营家族企业。

sentences.en: At the time, the business was called Elizabeth Trump and Son, after his grandmother and father.
sentences.zh: 当时，这家企业名为"伊丽莎白·特朗普父子"，这是以他的祖母和父亲命名的。

sentences.en: The work related to building, buying, and managing property.
sentences.zh: 这项工作与建造、购买和管理房产有关。

sentences.en: By his own telling, young Donald often created trouble in school.
sentences.zh: 据他自己讲述，年幼的唐纳德经常在学校惹麻烦。

sentences.en: So when he was 13 years old, his parents sent him to a military-style school.
sentences.zh: 所以当他13岁时，父母把他送到一所军事风格的学校。

sentences.en: Donald said that, for the most part, he enjoyed the experience.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德说，总的来说，他很喜欢这段经历。

sentences.en: Other students there remembered him as a good baseball player, as popular with girls, and as someone who wanted to succeed.
sentences.zh: 那里的其他学生把他记住是一名优秀的棒球运动员，很受女孩欢迎，也是一个渴望成功的人。

sentences.en: Trump went on to college first at Fordham University in New York, and then at the University of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 特朗普之后进入大学，先是在纽约的福特汉姆大学，然后又在宾夕法尼亚大学。

sentences.en: He earned a degree in economics.
sentences.zh: 他获得了经济学学位。

sentences.en: He was also already investing in real estate.
sentences.zh: 他此前已经开始投资房地产。

sentences.en: After he graduated, Trump quickly returned to New York City and his career.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，特朗普迅速回到纽约市，投身于他的事业。

sentences.en: In time, he became the head of the family business.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他成为了这家家族企业的负责人。

sentences.en: He re-named it the Trump Organization.
sentences.zh: 他将其更名为特朗普集团。

sentences.en: As its president, Trump developed and put his name on luxury buildings, casinos, hotels, and golf courses around the world.
sentences.zh: 作为总裁，特朗普在世界各地开发并冠名了豪华建筑、赌场、酒店和高尔夫球场。

sentences.en: Later, he became linked to the entertainment industry, too.
sentences.zh: 后来，他也与娱乐业产生了关联。

sentences.en: He became a part owner of beauty pageants, hosted a television show, and wrote a book about how to succeed in business.
sentences.zh: 他成为选美比赛的共同所有者，主持了一档电视节目，并写了一本关于如何在商界取得成功的书。

sentences.en: During those years, Trump also married three times and divorced twice.
sentences.zh: 在那些年里，特朗普还三次结婚，两次离婚。

sentences.en: The media wrote especially about his first and second marriages because he openly had a relationship with his second wife while he was married to his first.
sentences.zh: 媒体尤其关注他的第一次和第二次婚姻，因为他在与第一任妻子婚姻存续期间，公开地与第二任妻子交往。

sentences.en: In 2005, he married Melania Knauss, a former model from Slovenia.
sentences.zh: 2005年，他与前斯洛文尼亚模特梅拉尼亚·克瑙斯结婚。

sentences.en: She is only the second first lady who was not born in the United States.
sentences.zh: 她是第二位并非出生在美国的第一夫人。

sentences.en: The first was Louisa Adams, who came from Britain in 1801.
sentences.zh: 第一位是1801年来自英国的路易莎·亚当斯。

sentences.en: All together, Trump has three sons and two daughters.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，特朗普有三个儿子和两个女儿。

sentences.en: Because Trump has been a public figure for most of his life, many Americans were familiar with him before he ran for president.
sentences.zh: 由于特朗普一生中大部分时间都是公众人物，许多美国人在他竞选总统之前就已对他有所了解。

sentences.en: To some, he is linked to success in business and branding.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，他与商业成功和品牌建设联系在一起。

sentences.en: To others, notes journalist Jackie Calmes, he is linked to debt and legal battles.
sentences.zh: 而对另一些人来说，记者杰基·凯姆斯指出，他与债务和法律纠纷联系在一起。

sentences.en: But, until he officially entered the 2016 campaign as a Republican candidate, few linked him to politics.
sentences.zh: 但是，在他以共和党候选人身份正式加入2016年竞选之前，很少有人将他与政治联系在一起。

sentences.en: Trump is unusual among past presidents in that he had never worked in the government before.
sentences.zh: 在历届总统中，特朗普与众不同，因为他此前从未在政府部门工作过。

sentences.en: Nor has Trump served in the military.
sentences.zh: 特朗普也从未服过兵役。

sentences.en: Only Presidents Taylor, Grant, and Eisenhower had no past government experience; however, they had all been generals.
sentences.zh: 只有泰勒、格兰特和艾森豪威尔三位总统没有过往的政府工作经历；不过，他们都曾担任过将军。

sentences.en: During the campaign for president, other candidates spent money to buy advertising.
sentences.zh: 在总统竞选期间，其他候选人花钱购买广告。

sentences.en: But Trump spread his message on free television, radio and social media.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普在免费的电视、广播和社交媒体上传播他的信息。

sentences.en: Trump won the Republican nomination over 16 candidates.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在16位候选人中脱颖而出，赢得了共和党提名。

sentences.en: He went on to defeat Democratic Party nominee Hillary Clinton to win the presidency.
sentences.zh: 他随后击败了民主党候选人希拉里·克林顿，赢得了总统大选。

sentences.en: Trump was 70 years old when he was sworn in.
sentences.zh: 特朗普就职时已经70岁了。

sentences.en: Trump was unusual in how he communicated with the public.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在与公众沟通方面与众不同。

sentences.en: As a president, he continued to use Twitter, now known as X, to communicate his thoughts directly to anyone who wanted to follow him.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，他继续使用推特（现名为X），直接向所有想关注他的人传达自己的想法。

sentences.en: Many earlier presidents also used changes in technology to interact with the public.
sentences.zh: 许多前任总统也利用技术变革与公众互动。

sentences.en: Woodrow Wilson was the first to hold press conferences regularly with reporters.
sentences.zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊是第一位定期与记者举行新闻发布会的总统。

sentences.en: Franklin Roosevelt famously spoke to Americans on the radio. John F.
sentences.zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福以通过广播向美国人发表演讲而闻名。约翰·F.

sentences.en: Kennedy – and later Richard Nixon – are credited with using television to their advantage.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪——以及后来的理查德·尼克松——被认为善于利用电视为自己谋利。

sentences.en: While the long-term effects of Trump’s presidency are not yet known, he will likely be remembered in part for his direct and unscripted style of communication.
sentences.zh: 虽然特朗普总统的长期影响尚不清楚，但他很可能因其直接且未经设计的沟通风格而被人们铭记。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。
